notes: Prices quoted per tola (11.664 g) and per 10 g; 22K and 21K jewelry are common. Local jewelry supplies carry 3% sales tax (no input adjustment); monetary (unworked) gold is exempt; a separate 1% adjustable advance tax applies on sale of gold/silver. Large unofficial/smuggling channel exists. No sourced premium, making or buyback figures.
